name: Egham to Runnymede Countryside Circular Walk
summary: National Trust's circular trail, about 5.9 km, from Egham Station, Station Road.
notes: Route line from OpenStreetMap, built on the date shown. Nobody from Driftway has walked it, so surfaces and barriers are as mapped, not as found.

The trail is National Trust's. Check their page on the day for opening times, parking, livestock and conditions: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/surrey/runnymede-and-ankerwycke/egham-to-runnymede-countryside-circular-walk
review: 9 places where the mapped paths don't join; the route may be incomplete or out of order in OpenStreetMap
